name: Safi cobalt serving bowl
description: Wheel-thrown in Safi and hand-painted in cobalt and white. Deep enough for salads, couscous or a pile of clementines. Food safe; hand wash to keep the glaze bright.

name: Fès zellige plate, 30 cm
description: A wall or table plate painted with the eight-pointed star of Fès zellige tilework. Each one is painted freehand, so the lines vary slightly from plate to plate.

name: Tamegroute green bowl
description: The deep, uneven green glaze of Tamegroute, made in the Draa valley in wood-fired kilns. No two bowls come out the same colour.

name: Terracotta cooking tagine, 28 cm
description: Unglazed cooking tagine for gas or charcoal, sized for four. Soak it before the first use and it will last for years of slow-cooked stews.

name: Painted serving tagine
description: A serving tagine painted in blue and saffron for bringing food to the table. Not for the stove: keep it for serving and display.

name: Saffron serving plate
description: A wide, shallow plate in saffron and ink. Big enough for a full plate of msemen.

name: Olive dishes, set of 4
description: Four little dishes in mixed glazes for olives, harissa and preserved lemons.

name: Pomegranate wall plate
description: Painted with ripe pomegranates in red and green. A hook on the back for hanging.

name: Beni Ourain rug, 150 × 240 cm
description: Hand-knotted from undyed sheep's wool by Beni Ourain weavers in the Middle Atlas. Thick, soft pile with the tribe's dark diamond lattice.

name: Boucherouite rag rug, 120 × 180 cm
description: Woven from strips of recycled fabric, so each one is a one-off burst of colour. Light enough to move from room to room.

name: Kilim hallway runner, 70 × 300 cm
description: A flat-woven runner in madder red and indigo. Reversible, and tough enough for a busy hallway.

name: Azilal rug, 100 × 160 cm
description: Bright symbols on a cream field, knotted by women weavers in the Azilal region. This one has sold, but we expect more after the next market.

name: Sabra cactus-silk cushion, indigo
description: Woven from sabra, the silky fibre of the agave plant, which shimmers as you move. Cover only, 45 × 45 cm, with a zip.

name: Sabra cactus-silk cushion, saffron
description: The same sabra weave in warm saffron. Cover only, 45 × 45 cm.

name: Pierced brass star lantern
description: Hand-pierced brass that throws star patterns across the walls when lit. Fitted for a standard E27 bulb, with a 1 m chain.

name: Hammered copper lantern
description: Hammered copper that warms to a rich patina over time. Works with a candle or an E14 bulb.

name: Coloured glass lantern
description: Panels of coloured glass set in a metal frame. Beautiful with a single candle on a terrace.

name: Pierced globe pendant lamp
description: A round pierced pendant that fills a room with a lace of light. Ceiling plate and 1.2 m cable included.

name: Berrad teapot, silver finish
description: The classic Moroccan teapot, with the tall curved spout made for pouring from height. Holds 6 glasses.

name: Engraved brass teapot
description: Brass engraved by hand with a star medallion. Holds 4 glasses.

name: Beldi tea glasses, green, set of 6
description: Mouth-blown recycled glass with tiny bubbles and a soft green tint. Each set varies a little.

name: Gold-rim tea glasses, set of 6
description: Clear glasses with gold rims and painted stars, for special occasions.

name: Engraved tea tray, 40 cm
description: A round brass tray engraved with a geometric border. The centre of every tea ceremony.

name: Leather pouf, tan
description: Goat leather stitched by hand in the Marrakech medina. Ships unstuffed: fill it with old blankets or cushions.

name: Embroidered leather pouf, white
description: White leather with saffron embroidery. Ships unstuffed.

name: Babouche slippers, saffron
description: Soft leather slippers with a folded-down back. Sizes 36 to 45; choose yours in the order note.

name: Babouche slippers, red
description: The same babouche in deep red. Sizes 36 to 45; add your size in the order note.

name: Palm market basket
description: Woven doum palm with leather handles. The basket everyone carries to the market.

name: Lidded Berber basket
description: A tall lidded basket with indigo stripes. For laundry, blankets or plants.

name: Arched mirror with bone inlay
description: An arched mirror framed in carved wood with bone inlay. 50 × 80 cm, with a hanging wire.

name: Thuya wood box
description: Polished thuya wood from Essaouira with a lemonwood star on the lid. For jewellery or tea.
